name: @astrosheep/keiyaku-v4

scripts.build: node --input-type=module -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('build', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm run test:architecture && npm run test:maintainability && npm run test:reachability && node --import tsx --test tests/**/*.test.ts tests/maintainability.test.js && npm run test:dogfood
scripts.test:dogfood: npm run build && node --import tsx --test tests/day1-shell-dogfood.dogfood.ts

description: Keiyaku v4 is a clean implementation of an agent-facing contract workflow.
